content_html:
Application Tracking System • Openink Hub

Hire faster with an Application Tracking System built for growing teams.

Manual hiring can't keep up with a growing business. Openink Hub's ATS automates job posting, resume screening, candidate shortlisting, and interview coordination — so your team spends less time sorting applications and more time hiring the right people, faster and at lower cost.

Quick answer: An application tracking system automates hiring tasks. Openink Hub's ATS handles job posting, resume screening, candidate shortlisting and interview coordination, so recruiters spend less time sorting applications and more time choosing the right people. It is built for growing teams that have outgrown manual hiring.

Benefits

Why growing teams choose our ATS

Every benefit is built around one goal — cutting the cost and effort of hiring while improving the quality of every candidate that reaches your team.

  • Cut time-to-hire by automating resume screening and shortlisting
  • Reduce hiring costs by replacing manual coordination with one system
  • Give every hiring manager a single, real-time view of the pipeline
  • Avoid losing strong candidates to slow, manual response times
  • Standardize your hiring process across every role and department
  • Scale hiring volume up or down without adding recruiter headcount
  • Improve candidate experience with faster, clearer communication
  • Make data-backed hiring decisions with pipeline analytics and reports

Features

Everything you need to run hiring end-to-end

From the first job posting to the final offer letter, every stage of recruitment lives in one connected system.

Sourcing

Multi-Channel Job Posting

Publish open roles across job boards and career pages from a single dashboard, no repeated manual postings.

Screening

AI Resume Screening

Automatically parse resumes and rank candidates against role requirements, so only qualified applicants reach your inbox.

Pipeline

Visual Candidate Pipeline

Track every applicant through each hiring stage — applied, screened, interviewed, offered — in one Kanban-style view.

Scheduling

Automated Interview Scheduling

Let candidates self-book interview slots synced to your team's calendars, eliminating back-and-forth emails.

Collaboration

Team Feedback & Scorecards

Collect structured interviewer feedback and scorecards in one place for faster, more consistent hiring decisions.

Communication

Automated Candidate Updates

Keep applicants informed with automatic status updates by email or WhatsApp, improving candidate experience.

Compliance

Centralized Candidate Records

Store resumes, communication history, and documents securely in one searchable, audit-ready record per candidate.

Insights

Hiring Analytics & Reports

Track time-to-hire, source effectiveness, and pipeline drop-off with built-in dashboards and reports.

Onboarding

Offer & Onboarding Handoff

Move selected candidates straight into onboarding with document collection and offer letters generated automatically.

Integration

HRMS & CRM Integration

Connect hiring data directly with your HRMS and CRM so candidate and employee records stay in sync.

Access

Role-Based Team Access

Give recruiters, hiring managers, and interviewers the right level of access to each requisition and candidate.

Scalability

Bulk Hiring Support

Handle high-volume hiring drives with bulk resume uploads, automated shortlisting, and batch scheduling.

How it works

From job post to offer letter in four steps

01

Post the role

Create a requisition once and publish it across job boards and your careers page in a single click.

02

Let AI screen and shortlist

Incoming applications are automatically parsed, scored, and ranked so your team only reviews qualified candidates.

03

Interview and collaborate

Schedule interviews automatically and gather structured feedback from every interviewer in one place.

04

Offer and onboard

Generate the offer letter and hand the new hire straight into onboarding — no re-entering data, no delays.

Ask us anything

Frequently Asked Questions About Our ATS

What is an Applicant Tracking System (ATS)?

An Applicant Tracking System (ATS) is recruitment software that helps businesses automate the hiring process by collecting applications, screening resumes, tracking candidates, scheduling interviews, and managing recruitment workflows from a single platform.

How does an ATS improve the hiring process?

An ATS streamlines recruitment by automatically organizing applications, filtering qualified candidates, reducing manual tasks, improving collaboration among hiring teams, and shortening the overall time-to-hire.

Can an ATS screen resumes automatically?

Yes. Most modern ATS platforms use keyword matching, AI-powered parsing, and customizable filters to identify candidates whose skills and experience best match the job requirements.

Is an ATS suitable for small and medium-sized businesses?

Yes. An ATS helps businesses of all sizes manage hiring more efficiently, reduce administrative work, improve candidate communication, and scale recruitment as the company grows.

Can an ATS integrate with job portals and HR software?

Yes. Many ATS solutions integrate with job boards, career pages, HRMS platforms, payroll systems, calendars, email tools, and communication platforms to simplify the recruitment process.

What features should I look for in an ATS?

Key features include resume parsing, AI candidate screening, interview scheduling, job posting, candidate tracking, collaboration tools, analytics, automated communication, reporting, and integration with existing HR systems.
